steps.title: Take the sample
steps.instruction: Take the feed sample out of this load on camera.

steps.title: Grind and weigh
steps.instruction: Grind the sample and weigh out 5 g on camera.

steps.title: Mix and shake
steps.instruction: Add the extraction solution and shake for 3 minutes on camera.

steps.title: Let it sit
steps.instruction: Leave the mixture to settle for 1 hour. The next step unlocks when the hour has passed.

steps.title: Dilute and fill the well
steps.instruction: Draw the clear liquid, dilute it as the kit table directs, and fill the microwell on camera.

steps.title: Place the strip
steps.instruction: After 3 minutes in the well, place the test strip and let it develop for 8 minutes — on camera.

steps.title: Read the strip
steps.instruction: Remove the pad, read the strip within 1 minute, photograph it immediately and record the reading.
